## Context / Problem
Eighteen Python modules under `tests/unit` contain 31 audited prose blocks: 25 true leading docstrings and 6 full-line comment regions. Scope was revalidated against `origin/main@9e6a0e436520f67962c22dc244d7b4f77f5bee45`. The old ranges included decorators, assignments, and assertions and missed two now-stale docstrings after ADR 0111 moved operator-attested ownership from `workflow_ops` to `decide_ops`; the stable allowlist corrects both.

## Approach
Edit only the stable-ID blocks below. For every owned path, retain immutable before and final blobs and parse both with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`. On comparison copies, remove only an allowlisted leading `Expr(Constant(str))` that is the first statement of a `Module`, `ClassDef`, `FunctionDef`, or `AsyncFunctionDef`; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; require the remaining normalized ASTs to match.

Tokenize both blobs and reject every changed inline comment or non-allowlisted full-line comment. Preserve non-docstring runtime strings, regexes, prompts, imports, decorators, annotations, assertions, subprocess arguments, test data, shebangs, and complete directive-bearing physical lines exactly. Adjacent blank-line normalization is allowed only around an edited block.

## Stable block allowlist
- `tests/unit/test_create_duplicate_warning.py`: `D:<module>`
- `tests/unit/test_criteria_overlay.py` — 2 blocks:
  - `C:<module>:before:def test_malformed_applies_to_rejected_at_overlay_load(tmp_path, bad_applies_to):`

`D:<symbol>` is a true leading docstring. `C:<scope>:before:<code>` is one maximal full-line comment region anchored to unchanged code. No other prose is editable. In reviewer TSV, `stable_block_id` is the path-qualified `<path>#<D:...>` or `<path>#<C:...>` value.

## Protected false positives
All unlisted prose and executable lines from the old spans are protected, including the current concise shim-removal and import-cycle docstrings in `test_decide_ops_seam.py`. The two extra operator-attested IDs above are not generic expansion: their text still names the retired `workflow_ops` owner and must be corrected to the current `decide_ops` contract.

## Preserved contracts and consumers
- Creation/criteria prose keeps nonblocking duplicate advice; fail-closed overlay shape; repository-wide empty-change behavior; immutable snapshots; vocabulary exceptions; effectiveness reproducibility; preview outcomes; and sanitized project-criterion authoring.
- Route/DC prose keeps route-derived warnings, the intentional policy baseline, stderr propagation, swallowed-diagnostic guards, and projects-seed scrub ordering.
- Plan/completion prose keeps ADR-0111 canonical ownership, import seams, deterministic decomp shape, constant delivered-child scans, verified delivery, bounded delta fallback, and portable advisory wiring.
- Deprecation/description/DET prose keeps an empty registry as valid, replacement rules for future entries, nonblocking cap warnings, clarity floors, and the current `decide_ops` identity/recognition contract.
- All modules are direct pytest inputs. Mechanism baselines identify autouse fixtures; the criteria-vocabulary allowlist, decomp eval spec, portability/overlay tests, and `_deprecations.py` source guards reference these paths. No target import, `__doc__`, `inspect.getdoc`, or pydoc consumer was found.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only declared stable-ID blocks and adjacent blank lines change; normalized-AST and token/comment comparisons pass on every owned path.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter and retains its listed current contract while removing chronology, duplication, obvious narration, or separator ornament.
- [ ] An independent reviewer posts one leaf-linked TSV row per block: `stable_block_id<TAB>before_citation<TAB>final_citation<TAB>preserved_contract_or_consumer<TAB>directives_exact<TAB>before_words<TAB>after_words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer_session`.
- [ ] Before citations use `9e6a0e436520f67962c22dc244d7b4f77f5bee45:<path>#<stable-id>`; final citations use `<final-commit-sha>:<path>#<stable-id>`; every row records `directives_exact=PASS`, `semantic-preservation=PASS`, and `bloat-removal=PASS`.
- [ ] All five structured verify commands pass.

## Verification
The five DD-level commands recorded on this ticket run focused pytest (including real consumers), scoped Ruff check plus format-check, comment hygiene, owned-path `git diff --check`, and worktree-venv `make verify`. They are the executable completion oracle.
